item.text: {"items":[{"id":"g1","options":[{"text":"Leydig cell","verdict":"plausible","reason":"A nearby fetal testicular cell with a different endocrine role."},{"text":"Granulosa cell","verdict":"plausible","reason":"An ovarian cell that can also produce anti-Mullerian hormone."},{"text":"Spermatogonium","verdict":"weak","reason":"A testicular cell, but not a likely choice for hormone secretion."},{"text":"None of the above","verdict":"throwaway","reason":"A hedge option."}]},{"id":"g2","options":[{"text":"Leuprolide","verdict":"plausible","reason":"A GnRH agonist used in prostate cancer; a classic agonist–antagonist confusion."},{"text":"Flutamide","verdict":"plausible","reason":"A prostate cancer drug that blocks androgen receptors rather than GnRH receptors."},{"text":"Finasteride","verdict":"weak","reason":"A prostate-related drug, but its 5-alpha-reductase mechanism is less easily confused with GnRH antagonism."},{"text":"Amoxicillin","verdict":"throwaway","reason":"An unrelated antibiotic."}]},{"id":"g3","options":[{"text":"Isthmus of the uterine tube","verdict":"plausible","reason":"Another segment of the uterine tube."},{"text":"Uterine fundus","verdict":"plausible","reason":"A reproductive tract location a student might confuse with the site of fertilization."},{"text":"Infundibulum of the uterine tube","verdict":"plausible","reason":"A segment of the uterine tube near the ovary."},{"text":"Both the ampulla and the fundus","verdict":"throwaway","reason":"A both-of-the-above hedge."}]},{"id":"g4","options":[{"text":"21-hydroxylase","verdict":"plausible","reason":"Another congenital adrenal hyperplasia enzyme deficiency that can cause virilization."},{"text":"17-alpha-hydroxylase","verdict":"plausible","reason":"Another congenital adrenal hyperplasia enzyme deficiency associated with hypertension."},{"text":"Aromatase","verdict":"plausible","reason":"Its deficiency can virilize a 46,XX infant, though hypertension does not fit."},{"text":"Left anterior descending artery","verdict":"throwaway","reason":"An artery rather than an enzyme."}]}]}
